criteria.evidence: packages/credentials/src/workerd.integration.test.ts issues, verifies, revokes, then rejects an API key through workerd.
The workerd integration test uses outboundService for HTTPS discovery, authorization, token exchange, JWKS verification, callback, and later cookie-authenticated request.
OIDC discovery snapshots its inputs before lazy execution and accepts caller-supplied Fetch without runtime detection; credentials test and typecheck pass.
